scope: Selected relevant runtime changes, plus all production-path file differences; no blind merge

patch_checks.subject: Plugin: clamp viewport depth to 0..1 (NVK asserts on anything else; Live Text aborted); test fixture lists the WindowServer display trace
Plugin: never lock a command buffer or queue the app can lock (Unity hang)
NVK: open the /dev/null placeholder fd read-only, so browser GPU sandboxes can open the device (WebGL)
Plugin: pixel-sampler variants re-translate the linked stages (#72)
Translator: emit a raw-cursor helper after its callers (CoreImage Lanczos, System Settings glyphs)
plugin: passes with sample positions draw at the standard positions when the GPU has no programmable-position path (Chess drew nothing); getDefaultSamplePositions always answers
NVK: a stale sample count from an earlier MSAA pass no longer aborts the app in an internal copy draw (Chess crashed in glReadPixels); draw with the render's layout and warn once

Review of community plugin changes: surface uploads keep a per-thread staging buffer (bounded to 32 MB) but wait for the copy (an image freed right after upload was still being written); storage twin created under the texture's lock; swizzled textures are never re-homed (their view would outlive the image); AIR member names checked before slicing
Plugin: honour MTLTextureDescriptor.swizzle for sampled reads (Icon Composer gray layers, #79)
Preserve queued surface contents and detach pooled clients
Reclaim pending surface slots and preserve display wake retries
Correct monitor flags, boot timings and surface upload copies
NVRMFB: login window black on high-refresh monitors; screen dark in driver-off starts
NVRM: the GPU's ACPI _DSM/_DOD are evaluated only with nvrmacpibl=1 (1.14 called them for every GPU; PCs hung at GPU start right after the _DSM call)
NVAccel: a copied frame waits for the surface's newest pixels (or keeps the last frame, at most 4 in a row) - full-screen flicker on machines whose frames take the copy path
NVAccel: revert keeping the scanout across a page-off (fa48d91)
